items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Good looking girl too, wasn't she? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes. But a great pianist.

ctx.x: Good looking girl too, wasn't she?
Yes. But a great pianist. She was a musician she was. She didn't play like we did. Yes, I'm picking up, she would buy all that music and play it. Could play it.
